crossRefs.note: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of…
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
“The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

translations.web: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
translations.bsb: These were the clans of Naphtali, and their registration numbered 45,400.
translations.kjv: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
translations.asv: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
